visualCharacteristics.purpose: borderless image teaser grid linking to sub-pages
traits: heading, paragraph and arrow CTA link
2-up by default, 3-up with three-up at desktop

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per card. Cell 1: image (alt required). Cell 2: heading (any level; H3 recommended, H2 on campaign pages), description paragraph(s), CTA link as the last paragraph (rendered as an arrow link; authored bold/italic button formatting is dropped). Cells may be merged or missing: the first picture of the row is the media, everything else is the body; a row without an image renders text only. Default 2 per row from 600px; option three-up = 3 per row from 900px with a smaller title. No label rows; all texts are authored

usage: Hub pages (/{country}/{lang}/baggage), app-entry (/online-check-in: "Your check-in with Lufthansa"), campaign (/100-years stories).
reuseGuidance: Use for borderless image teasers. For bordered cards (carousel on mobile) use carousel-cards; for destination tiles with prices use cards-price.
